content_sections.heading: Amrita Lab Assistant Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee, the pay or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a university, and this vacancy is at its Amritapuri Campus. The post sits in the Green Hydrogen Lab, which works on hydrogen production, hydrogen storage, carbon capture, batteries and fuel cells.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Lab Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: BSc in Chemistry or Physics. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Lab Assistant Duties
content_sections.text: The Lab Assistant will keep the lab running smoothly from day to day and support researchers in their experimental work. The key responsibilities are: Handling routine laboratory operations Preparing and handling chemicals and materials safely Preparing samples for experiments Maintaining laboratory equipment and facilities Assisting researchers during experiments Keeping laboratory records accurate and up to date

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Lab Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Lab Assistant job page on the Amrita website . Use the Apply Now or Apply Online option on that page to submit your application. For details about the post, write to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Where is the Amrita Lab Assistant post based?
faq.answer: The post is in the Green Hydrogen Lab at the Amritapuri Campus, and the notice gives the location as Kollam, Keralam.

faq.question: Q2. Which degree is required for this post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a BSc in Chemistry or Physics.

faq.question: Q3. What work will the Lab Assistant do with chemicals?
faq.answer: The Lab Assistant will prepare and handle chemicals and materials safely, and will also prepare samples for experiments.
